scenarios.desc_en: Dec–Jan. All 20 mallards stay at their central-west wetlands and fly out to feed at night. Only 5 of the 20 birds come within 3 km of a farm. Low risk.

scenarios.desc_en: Dec–Jan. A cold wave on 27–30 Dec freezes northern wetlands. 16 birds move south into the farm-dense Gimje–Naju area and feed near poultry farms. High risk after the cold wave.

scenarios.desc_en: Feb–Apr. The birds leave Korea between 20 Feb and 18 Mar via the Han and Yalu estuaries to NE China and Russia. Farm contact falls as they leave.
